_comment: Every Postgres-gated test package in backend/, run at this branch tip against a real database. Postgres tests are OPT-IN (GOATOS_RUN_POSTGRES_TESTS=1), so none of this is visible to a default `go test ./...` or to the ordinary CI path — a package can be entirely red for months and every green run stays green.
howToReadIt: FOUR of these start their OWN Docker container rather than using the shared pgtest harness, so they fail on a machine without Docker and say nothing about the code. ONE is the harness's own self-test asserting a template DSN that the external-DSN mode does not create. The REST are real assertion or seed failures at this tip.

reportedSeparately: ./cmd/partition-maintainer — calls goatos_ensure_partition_coverage, which migration 000212 deliberately DROPPED; the command was never retired and is still scheduled daily
